correctness.rationale: For all m≥2, the displayed Kraus operators satisfy Σ E_a*E_a=I. Since each branch projector Q_j=|e_{j+1}><e_{j+1}| belongs to the channel operator system and rank(Q_j)=1, scalar compression P Q_j P=λ_j P forces λ_j=0 for any code quantum block dimension≥2, hence the entire block lies in the protected C=span(e0,e1) and can have dimension only 2. Cross terms E0*Ej=α_j|e1><e_{j+1}| then force scalar code lines coexisting with that block to be supported only on the z exactly zero-overlap coordinates. These z coordinate lines attain the maximum hybrid algebra M2⊕C^z. The orthogonal output supports f0,φ1,...,φ_m yield C^{m+1}; output dimension rules out any larger classical message count. The *-embedding relation C^{m+1}≤M2⊕C^z iff m+1≤z+2, and z≤m−1, proves the two maximal types and the unique dominating aligned case. Haar-random orthonormal basis has every α_j≠0 almost surely, so z=0. Representative packaged code was inspected, but generality follows algebraically not from finite examples.
